acceptance: Measurement (read-only, after the hold date): count and total size of real `datagen/` and `databases/` directories under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/*/` and one level deeper, excluding the shared `datagen/` and `databases/`, split into created before and after 2026-11-22; the same for `/tmp` and the user temp directory; size of the shared `datagen/`. Record the commands and numbers in context next to the baseline.

Decision gate: the rule holds if directories created after 2026-11-22 total under 5 GiB and each belongs to a run that was still active at measurement time. If it holds, close with the numbers and no tooling. If not, ask the owner to choose between a report-only check in `make heavy-status`/`make disk-check` and a deleting sweep; do not build either before that answer.
If a sweep is chosen it is a separate item with its own acceptance; this item only records the decision and links the successor.

`DirectoryManager.clean_old_files`: either deleted as unused (with its tests, if any) or wired to a documented command. Deleting it does not need the measurement and may land first. It must never be wired to run implicitly inside `benchbox run`.
Verification rubric: every number is from a live read on the measurement day, with the command shown; no number is carried over from the 2026-11-22 baseline or from session memory.

Guardrails: this item deletes nothing under benchmark_runs or /tmp; it never touches a directory with open files (`lsof +D`) or a run named in `make heavy-status`; result files and dated experiment directories are evidence and are out of scope; do not clear this item's hold early to get work.
context: Origin: disk cleanup and root-cause review on 2026-11-22. The root volume fell to 46 GiB free, below the 50 GiB heavy-work floor. Cause found: generated benchmark data has no lifecycle (any session creates it under any run root, nothing removes it), and Time Machine local snapshots kept deleted data allocated. PR #4451 (https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4451) added AGENTS.md [RUN-DATA-001] and made scripts/run_version_matrix.py delete its datagen/ and databases/ when a matrix completes.
description:
Problem: [RUN-DATA-001] in AGENTS.md is an instruction with no mechanical check. Before it existed, session transcripts set a per-run `BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR` about as often as the shared one, and 127 of 154 run folders were less than two months old. Whether the instruction changes that is unknown.

Baseline taken 2026-11-22 after cleanup: `~/Developer/benchmark_runs` 131 GiB; shared `datagen/` about 8 GiB; `datagen` folders outside the shared one: 12 real folders, 24.4 GiB, all in two runs started before the rule merged (`std-scales-20261122`, `gvg-sf1-20261122`), plus 7 dangling symlinks; 101 `datagen` folders under `/tmp` and the user temp directory.

Related dead code: `DirectoryManager.clean_old_files` in `benchbox/cli/config.py` (30-day age-based deletion over results, datagen and databases) has no caller.

Expected outcome: a measured answer after two weeks of normal use, and a decision based on it: nothing more needed, or a sweep/guard. The hold date is the end of that window.
